system.description: Touch an ally to bless them. Faith is a loan, and your god keeps the ledger.

outcomes.triumph: The ally has Boon on their next test, and you suffer no backlash whatever the result.
outcomes.success: The ally has Boon on their next test. If they fail it, the backlash deals d6 damage to you. If they succeed, you regain d4 HP.
outcomes.ruin: The ledger is called in: you take d6 damage. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
